capabilities: Publish selected notes from a source folder to Confluence Cloud
Preview remote page and attachment version changes
Import new Confluence pages and attachments as local Markdown
Resolve text conflicts and restore local backups
Generate local Mermaid PNG images for publication
disambiguation: Not a general Confluence client; it only syncs one configured vault folder with one Confluence folder, and publishing is off by default.
extras: Read-only by default; publishing and both automation options start disabled. Attachment limit 25 MiB per file. One designated publishing installation per Confluence folder; other installs should only preview or import. Conversion is a supported subset, not lossless; Mermaid image mode has size and diagram-type limits.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to publish a folder of notes to Confluence Cloud or to see and import remote Confluence edits.

requires.name: Atlassian account with access to the target Confluence Cloud folder
Scoped Atlassian API token stored in Obsidian SecretStorage

summary: Plugin that publishes a selected vault folder to Confluence Cloud and previews or imports remote page changes.
